name: Omastonk
author: Luca Nerlich
description: Omarchy bar widget for a rotating market watchlist

barWidget.description: Rotates through a watchlist of market symbols with live quotes.

schema.label: Symbols
schema.description: Watchlist of market symbols to rotate through, such as AAPL, SPY, BTC-USD, or ^GSPC.

schema.label: Active symbol
schema.description: Symbol shown when the widget loads.

schema.label: Rotate seconds
schema.description: Seconds each symbol stays on the bar before rotating. 0 disables rotation.

schema.label: Display mode
schema.description: Bar label density: full (symbol price percent glyph), symbolPrice, priceOnly, or symbolOnly.

schema.label: Poll interval seconds
schema.description: Seconds between refreshes of each individual symbol (minimum 5).

schema.label: Chart interval
schema.description: Last selected chart range label: 5Y, 1Y, YTD, 6M, 1M, 5D, or 1D.
